user.title: Discover HDL LINK gateway
user.description: Auto-discovered {count} gateway(s) answering on UDP 6000 (broadcast + LAN sweep). Pick the gateway to connect; choose "Enter gateway IP manually" if it is not listed. If port 6000 is reported busy, close HDL LINK Setup Tool or any other tool holding it first.

data_description.port: Default 6000, must match the gateway panel setting

manual.title: Enter gateway manually
manual.description: Use when broadcast is blocked or the gateway lives on another subnet. The bus subnet number is detected automatically.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Gateway {host} (bus subnet {subnet} detected automatically) returned {count} device(s). Capabilities read from the bus: {summary}. Channels are expanded into switch/light entities automatically.

mapping.title: Assign functions and scenes
mapping.description:
Channels: {channel_hint}.
Scenes found: {scene_hint}.
Comma separated: dimmers 10.100/9, curtains 10.100/23, doorbell 10.3, scenes 1,3,5. Channels left unassigned become switches.

data_description.scenes: HDL LINK scene numbers 1-128; pressing the button sends a scene recall

error.cannot_connect: Gateway did not answer. Check IP, port and network.
error.no_devices: No device found while scanning. Check the gateway and bus wiring.
error.no_gateway: No gateway answered the broadcast. Pick "Enter gateway IP manually" or check whether port 6000 is taken.
error.port_in_use: Local UDP 6000 is busy. Close the HDL setup tool or any old bridge process.

init.title: Functions and scenes
init.description: Saved changes reload the integration automatically.
